Needs changes before merge. One blocking test failure requires `needs-rework`.

I read the complete diff and issue #3029. There is no earlier review to check.
The trial merge uses upstream/main `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`.
Its first parent is the PR head. The merge is clean.
I checked the laws from that upstream main.

What looks good:

- The guide gives complete configurations for four clients and both connection modes.
- The package paths agree with the installer, package scripts and asset resolver.
- The guide explains document ownership, saved edits, connection refusals and the read-only first check.
- The configuration formats agree with the linked primary client references.

Requested before merge:

1. `site/content/guide/automate/ai.md:189`: Keep the AI guide test green after this rewrite.
   This line replaces `Codex CLI` with `Codex`. The existing test still requires `Codex CLI`.
   `test_external_agents_and_four_worked_tasks` fails at `site/tests/test_ai_guide.py:35`:

   ```text
   AssertionError: 'Codex CLI' not found
   ```

   Restore `Codex CLI` here, or update the test to check the new guide structure and linked client coverage.
   Do not remove its coverage. The same four-test suite passes on bare upstream/main.

Local results:

- `git diff upstream/main...review-4091 --check`: pass.
- `RUSTC_WRAPPER= CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: pass; 0 steps, 0 failures.
  The dry run also selects 0 steps. This is not an application test-suite pass.
  The first cache-enabled attempt stalled before compiling xtask. I interrupted it and retried without the cache.
- `zola --root site build --output-dir /tmp/review-4091-site-render --force`: pass; 51 pages and 10 sections.
- Parse every JSON/TOML fence in both guides: pass. Six complete client configurations pass.
- Check both Claude Code argument arrays and internal page links: pass.
- Check that both pages end with the first check: pass.

Extra suites run:

- `RUSTC_WRAPPER= CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test ai_guide --test mcp_doc_drift -j 6`: pass.
  The test build passes. `ai_guide`: 3 pass. `mcp_doc_drift`: 6 pass.

- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_ai_guide.py -v`: 3 pass, 1 fails.
  Bare upstream/main: all 4 pass.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v`: 104 tests; 5 failures and 8 errors.
  Bare upstream/main: 104 tests; 4 failures and the same 8 errors.
  The one new failure is finding 1.

Pre-existing results, not blockers:

- `test_guide_icons`: missing `op-rotary-flow` and `tool-form-mill` site icons, plus the icon-set comparison.
- `test_operation_reference`: the reference lacks `RotaryFlow`.
- Both four-axis guide suites read the removed `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library.rs` file.
- The search-query suite cannot start `node` on this host.

These results reproduce on bare upstream/main. I did not establish an issue that tracks each exact failure.
Both the PR and bare main render successfully with Zola.

Scope and limits:

- This PR changes documentation only. It changes no G-code, geometry, collision checks or stock simulation.
- Mutations: not applicable. Goldens moved: none. UI screenshots: not applicable.
- Importer, fixture, catalog and golden suites are not selected by this diff.
- The two named application test binaries ran. No GUI build or clippy ran. No Rust source changes.
- Light and heavy lanes did not run. No code covered by those lanes changes.
- No client settings changed. No paid provider request, attached GUI session or cross-platform acceptance test ran.
- The review worktree and branch remain in place. No code changed, and no evidence was committed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

@mkinney, commit `76d8575a0ba36ee2503c00c450526d7981ecc673` addresses finding 1. It restores `Codex CLI` in `site/content/guide/automate/ai.md`. No tests changed.

The existing command `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_ai_guide.py -v` now passes all four tests. The run used Python's `-B` flag to avoid new bytecode files. Before the correction, the suite passed three tests and failed the `Codex CLI` check.

Repeated checks on this head:

- Whitespace: pass.
- JSON/TOML, six client configurations, Windows path escaping, shell arguments and ten internal links: pass.
- Cached v0.26.0 CLI: read-only initialization, `tools/list` and `list_operation_types` pass; 124 tools.
- Quick gate: exit 0, zero selected steps. This is not an application test-suite pass.
- GitHub: no checks reported. This is not green CI.

The PR body contains the corrected test evidence. Real client sessions, cross-platform execution, attached GUI, site rendering and light/heavy lanes were not run by this correction. No application rebuild ran.

The new head waits for a fresh review. Please recheck finding 1. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Label change: the rework at 76d8575 restores the `Codex CLI` text the four-test AI guide suite requires, and the trial merge with main is clean, so `needs-rework` is removed and `merge-ready` is set. `mergeable` is MERGEABLE and mergeStateStatus is CLEAN.
